<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/usi-course-registration">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_USICourseRegistration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Registration">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_WantsToRegister</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCourse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AccountExists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckUniversityRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_EligibleUniversity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestActivation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_WaitForActivationResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AccountReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogIn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TweetChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TweetFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TweetMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteCourseRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePaymentInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CourseTicketReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoFreeSlots</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SportsInstituteSystem" name="Sports institute system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SlotsAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowCoursesAndDates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WantsToRegister" name="Wants to register for a course"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" name="Are course slots free?" default="Flow_NoFreeSlots"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates" name="Tell applicant the available courses and dates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select a course"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check whether an account already exists"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountExists" name="Does an account already exist?" default="Flow_NoAccount"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckUniversityRegistration" name="Check registration at an eligible university"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" name="Registered at an eligible university?" default="Flow_NotEligible"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForActivationResponse" name="Wait for activation response">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ActivationResponse" messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountReady" name="Account available"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to the account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetChoice" name="Tweet to friends?" default="Flow_SkipTweet"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends who might want to join"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetMerge" name="Continue registration"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteCourseRegistration" name="Complete course registration"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation" name="Provide payment information"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CourseTicketReceived" name="Course ticket received"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoFreeSlots" name="No free course slots"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSlots" sourceRef="Start_WantsToRegister" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsFree" name="Slots are free" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" targetRef="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">slotsAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFreeSlots" name="No free slots" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" targetRef="End_NoFreeSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowToSelect" sourceRef="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToCheckAccount" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToAccountGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists" name="Account exists" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">accountExists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount" name="No account" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Task_CheckUniversityRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckUniversityToEligibility" sourceRef="Task_CheckUniversityRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Eligible" name="Registered at an eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">eligibleUniversityRegistration</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible" name="Not registered at an eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToWait" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_WaitForActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitToAccountReady" sourceRef="Event_WaitForActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToAccountReady" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountReadyToLogin" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountReady" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginToTweetChoice" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_TweetChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet" name="Tweet" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetChoice" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">tweetToFriends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipTweet" name="Do not tweet" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetChoice" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetToMerge" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetMergeToRegistration" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteCourseRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegistrationToPayment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteCourseRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToTicket" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation" targetRef="End_CourseTicketReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
